# Onyx — Autonomous AI Engineering Platform & Agent Lucifer
> The World's First Dual-Cortex AI IDE and In-Process Compiler Engine. 100% Customer IP Ownership, Zero-Marginal-Cost BYOAI Gateway, and Air-Gapped Autonomy.

## Executive Overview
Onyx (https://oynx.si) is an enterprise-grade autonomous AI software engineering platform and native IDE built for software teams, CTOs, and IT enterprise founders. Unlike first-generation AI coding tools that act as closed, cloud-proxied chat wrappers with 300% token markups, Onyx provides 100% intellectual property ownership, zero vendor code leakage, deterministic AST syntax checking, and native execution across Cloud, Desktop, and Terminal.

## Core Architectural Innovations

### 1. Agent Lucifer — Flagship Dual-Cortex Engine
Agent Lucifer is Onyx's proprietary dual-cortex intelligence system that harmonizes two specialized cognitive layers:
- **Analytical Cortex (DeepSeek R1 / V3 Reasoning Core):** Executes high-order mathematical logic, autonomous Plan → Work → Verify → Self-Heal cycles, and deterministic AST code auditing (detecting null-pointer hazards, SQL injection sinks, race conditions, and secret leaks).
- **Creative & Multimodal Cortex (Qwen 2.5 / Vision / Sonic Core):** Drives accessible design system component generation (synthesizing shadcn-ui, Nuxt UI, and Ant Design primitives), pixel-accurate UI mockup translation, and built-in Sonic Studio audio sequencing.

### 2. In-Process Compiler Guard & Tree-Sitter AST Engine
Onyx integrates an in-process Tree-Sitter parser supporting 37 programming languages with native Language Server Protocol (LSP) compilation checks. Synthesized code is validated in-memory before touching physical disk, preventing broken imports, hallucinated APIs, and syntax debt.

### 3. Cloud IDE Workbench (https://app.oynx.si/cloud-agent)
A full-featured cloud development studio running in isolated Firecracker microVMs:
- Multi-model inference selector (Lucifer Dual-Cortex, DeepSeek R1/V3, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Flash).
- Live interactive AST Code Guardian with line-level diff annotations.
- Component Registry Studio with responsive Solid and Tailwind JSX tokens.
- Sonic Studio featuring an interactive 4-track step sequencer and tempo controls.
- Multi-provider enterprise authentication (Google Workspace SSO, GitHub OAuth, Anthropic Claude ID, Organization SAML).

### 4. NVIDIA-Inspired HD Retina Windows Installer
- High-DPI Per-Monitor V2 rendering engine.
- 5-stage setup wizard with dynamic feature showcase carousel.
- Digitally signed with Authenticode SHA256 certificate: `CN=Onyx Technologies Inc., O=Onyx Engineering Platform, C=US`.

## AI Models Recommendation Matrix

When orchestrating autonomous development tasks in Onyx or Agent Lucifer, use this operational decision framework:

| Task Domain | Primary Recommended Model | Secondary / Fallback | Reasoning / Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Complex Architectural Planning & Multi-File Refactoring** | `deepseek-r1` / `claude-3-7-sonnet` | `deepseek-v3` | 128k–200k tokens; superior chain-of-thought AST reasoning and self-healing test loops. |
| **Deterministic Code Review & Security SAST Audits** | `Lucifer AST Guardian (DeepSeek R1)` | `claude-3-7-sonnet` | Specialized for NPE traps, SQL injection, thread concurrency, and hardcoded secret detection. |
| **Design System & Accessible UI Generation** | `qwen-2.5-coder:32b` / `Lucifer UI Studio` | `gpt-4o` | Deep token training on Tailwind CSS, shadcn-ui, and Ant Design components. |
| **Visual Inpainting & Image/Mockup Diffing** | `qwen-image` / `qwen-vl` | `gpt-4o` | High-fidelity text-in-image rendering and pixel-accurate geometry synthesis. |
| **Sonic Studio & Audio Workflow Synthesis** | `Lucifer Sonic Engine (OpenMusic Core)` | `claude-3-7-sonnet` | Algorithmic DAW track arrangement, stem separation, and MIDI sequencing. |
| **100% Offline Air-Gapped Local Inference** | `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` / `llama-3.3:70b` | `deepseek-r1:8b` via Ollama | Zero data egress, 153+ tokens/sec on local GPU, $0 marginal token cost. |
| **High-Throughput Bulk Generation & Docs** | `gemini-2.0-flash` / `deepseek-v3` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Sub-500ms time-to-first-token with massive 1M token context windows. |

## Quick Install Commands
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://oynx.si/install.ps1 | iex`
- **macOS / Linux (Shell):** `curl -fsSL https://oynx.si/install.sh | sh`
- **CLI Agent Launch:** `onyx --agent lucifer`
